column1: # C++ wire fixture — real `binary-cxx` output (`ConverterEncodeAuto`), not a
# re-implementation of its rules. The probe needs an external C++ checkout and
# links that checkout's `libbinary.a`, so it is machine-local and is not
# committed — how to rebuild it is in DESIGN §12.5. The table itself is
# committed and is the source of truth the test asserts against
# Every row is byte-identical to Rust's own output, length header included, so
# the test asserts exact equality. `binary-cxx` gained exact-length prediction
# for blittable containers in commit c6c11cb; before it, `vec_i32_5` kept a
# Six rows of `csharp.tsv` are absent on purpose: `binary-cxx` has no nullable
# `named_with_opt_none` and `named_with_opt_some` cannot be produced by it.
